hiringSignals.description: Job ad volume is the most accessible leading indicator of a company's office space pressure
hiringSignals.threshold: 5+ new role postings within a 4-week window = likely space planning event within 3–9 months
roleTypes_HighestSignal: Any role listing a new or not-yet-established office address
Operations Manager, Office Manager (indicates operational formalisation)
Multiple technical/professional roles in same function (rapid team growth)
hiringSignals.monitoringApproach: Set up SEEK/LinkedIn job alerts by company name for top 50 target companies quarterly

fundingSignals.description: Investment announcements are a reliable predictor of office expansion and fitout investment

signals.probability: High — office upgrade common within 6 months
signals.action: Contact CEO/COO within 7 days of announcement

signals.probability: Very High — scaling to new office/HQ common
signals.action: Contact within 48 hours — they move fast at this stage

signals.probability: Medium — may still be coworking, but watch for follow-on

leadershipChanges.description: New senior leadership often triggers office transformation as a way of setting cultural tone
highValueChanges: New CEO — frequently triggers culture/brand refresh of physical space
New Head of People/HR — tends to prioritise employee environment upgrades
New COO — likely to review operational efficiency including workspace
leadershipChanges.approachTiming: Contact 4–8 weeks after appointment — allow time for them to settle, then approach with workspace assessment offer

expansionSignals.description: Physical expansion signals direct furniture needs
signals: New floor or building in existing location
New city or interstate office opening
Acquisition of another company (integration often triggers workspace consolidation)
Subletting part of current office (indicates both current and future space change)
